sentences.text: Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with S.T. Case No. 26/2024, arising out of Peshrar P.S. Case No. 06/2023, registered under Sections 342/ 376/ 504/ 506 of the Indian Penal Code, charges have been framed under sections 342/34, 376 r/w 109, 504/34, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Lohardaga.
On 03.06.2023 at about 04:30 P.M., the victim was dragged inside the room by co-accused Sonif Ansari and raped.
It is alleged that the petitioner had locked the room from outside and was standing guard.
This appears to be a case of gang rape.
It was submitted that the charge has been framed in this case.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
Learned court below shall expedite the trial.
(Ambuj Nath, J.) Saurabh uploaded Sattar Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
